premise: Vendors trade unfinished weather patterns beneath a planet-scale engine, where every transaction alters the local environment and social leverage.
simulation_objective: Manage the trade and release of atmospheric phenomena while navigating delivery disputes and environmental shifts.
economy_focus: Climate craft, weather lot auctions, and delivery logistics.
exploration_focus: Six connected market rooms with dynamic visibility and route changes based on active weather lots.
conflict_tone: Socially entangled disputes over environmental consequences and bargaining leverage.
visual_style: Storm-gray and celadon pixel art with electric-yellow and magenta accents; no text or logos.

agent_visual_policy.world_wardrobe_brief: Characters in the Night Market wear heavy, weather-resistant industrial attire designed for high-pressure environments and static-heavy meteorological crafting. Silhouettes are slim and vertical, dominated by storm-gray and celadon with high-visibility electric accents indicating professional rank.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Heavy use of celadon and brass highlights.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Bulky upper body with slim legs.

role_style_rules.palette_notes: Magenta accents on dark gray base.
role_style_rules.silhouette_notes: Asymmetrical with many small tool attachments.

visual_consistency_rules: No text or symbols on clothing; use color blocks for identification.
High-contrast flicker pixels for electric/magenta elements.
Strict top-down 90-degree perspective; no side-facing feet.
Materials must look wet or metallic via high-contrast highlights.

visual_canon.lighting: Global ambient storm-gray with high-contrast point-source flickers from electric-yellow conduits and magenta warning beacons.
architecture: modular market stalls with retractable silk awnings

terrain.ground: dark wet charcoal tiles with silver condensation sheen
terrain.edge: deep shadow gutters with magenta safety threading

sprite_language.role_readability: high-contrast accent color on gear (yellow for couriers, magenta for wardens)

visual_canon.world_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art, Night Market of Unfinished Weather, storm-gray and celadon palette, wet charcoal textures, meteorological industrial machinery, no text.
visual_canon.sprite_prompt_prefix: top-down pixel art character, meteorological trader, wearing electric-yellow silk and silver instruments, 32-bit style, no text.
